expected.raw_text: [Preferred] Experience using the Databricks Intelligence Platform

parsed.degree_signal: Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, etc.) or equivalent practical experience
parsed.notes:
The section 'What we look for:' is a requirements heading, so every item under it defaults to required. The '[Preferred]' inline marker makes Databricks and Apache Spark nice_to_have.
GenAI maps to llms through the alias 'genai'.
I did not add cloud, because the posting never names it. AWS, Azure and GCP are offered as 'AWS, Azure, or GCP', so they share alternative group 1.
HuggingFace, LangChain and DSPy follow 'tools such as' but are joined with 'and'. On the literal reading they are asked for together, so I did not group them.
LLMOps and ML appear in the Mission/company paragraph and are not asked of the candidate, so I skipped them as skills. ML is asked for separately in the requirements.
For 'deploying production-grade GenAI applications' I did not add ai-deployment, because its aliases name model deployment and this phrase only loosely matches.
'Graduate degree' is read as master level, which is a judgment call. The 'or equivalent practical experience' wording makes degree_or_equivalent true.
'Statistics' appears only as a degree discipline, not as a skill ask.
'Willing to travel' is not a skill.
